content.text:
I'd look at three things: a money-market fund (קרן כספית) for part of the 30,000 so it isn't sitting in the bank doing nothing, the S&P 500 card (I think through a "חשבון ניירות ערך" at my bank), and checking my קרן השתלמות, since I already have one through work. I'm not very sure. What clicked was the box at the top, "מאיפה להתחיל". It's the only place the page tells you where to start: קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה, and "כסף שצריך להישאר זמין: קרן כספית". The rest is just a long list of cards, and nothing tells you which one is better or what any of them costs.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **The big heading "מדריך".** It says it covers every kind of saving and investing, so I stayed.
- **"שני חלקים בכל חיסכון".** I read the first line, roughly: where the money is held vs what it's invested in. I skipped the small grey line under it.
- **"מאיפה להתחיל".** I read all three lines. This was the most useful part.
- **"איפה הכסף מוחזק".** I stopped on the card titles. Under "כסף שוטף וקצר": עו"ש, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון, קרן כספית, קרן כספית מתחדשת, מק"מ. Under "חיסכון עם הטבת מס": קרן השתלמות and קופת גמל להשקעה. I skipped the second one; it sounds like a thing for old people.
- **Skipped:** "פרישה" (my pension is already sorted through work) and "לילדים" (no kids). I glanced at "לבחירה עצמית" and saw "חשבון ניירות ערך": stocks and funds at a bank or investment house. I think that's the S&P thing from work.
- **"במה הכסף מושקע".** I looked for "S&P 500" and found it: "הכסף מושקע בדולרים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו". I passed over the other indexes (MSCI, נאסד"ק, ת"א-35/90/125) and the אג"ח cards.
- **The bottom.** A footer with links. The last screenshot was just a black strip.

**Words I didn't get:**
- "מק"מ" (it comes up twice)
- "אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה" / "לא צמודה", "צמודה למדד"
- "קופון"
- "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו"
- "מסלול כללי", "קרן כספית מתחדשת"
- "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים"
- "קופת גמל בניהול אישי" vs "קרן השתלמות בניהול אישי". No idea how either differs from the regular ones.

**Where I got stuck or bored:**
- The two-part idea ("איפה מוחזק" vs "במה מושקע") took me a second. Then I saw מק"מ in both sections and got confused again.
- About thirty cards, all the same grey box. By the index section it was all "מדד של... הכסף מושקע בשקלים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו" over and over, and I got bored.
- No numbers at all. No fees in shekels, no returns, nothing that says "this one is better for you". Nothing at the end said what to actually do or where to click.
- I wouldn't have closed the page, because "מאיפה להתחיל" kept me there. But on a phone I'd have given up halfway through the indexes.
- Nothing jumped or moved while I scrolled.
